::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Generated from a Repomix dump of the flake (`**/*.nix`). Covers every module, bundle and package in the tree.
:::

# Topology

| Layer | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Flake | `flake.nix` | Inputs, `devShells`, `nixosConfigurations`, `homeConfigurations`, `colmena` |
| Node descriptors | `nodes/ccN-node.nix` | Plain attrsets: `type`, `name`, `hostPlatform`, `user`, `modules`, `homeModules`, `deployment` |
| Node builder | `lib/mkNode.nix` | Single source of truth turning a node into `nixosSystem` or `homeManagerConfiguration` |
| Host system | `hosts/ccN/ccN-config.nix` | NixOS config: hostname, GPU, users, system-module imports |
| Host home | `hosts/ccN/ccN.nix` | Home-Manager config: imports `shared.nix`, per-host app toggles |
| Disk | `hosts/ccN/disko.nix` | Declarative GPT + btrfs (`@`, `@home`, `@nix`, zstd, noatime) |
| Shared HM entry | `modules/shared.nix` | Auto-imports **all** of `modules/bundles/` and `modules/apps/` |

: Repository layers {#tbl-layers tbl-colwidths="[18,27,55]"}

Hosts wired in `flake.nix`: **cc1**, **cc3**, **cc4**, plus an `installer` ISO.
All nodes are `x86_64-linux`, user `admin`, deployed by colmena over Tailscale (`ccN.tail92efad.ts.net`), tags `workstation` / `linux`.

::: {.callout-warning}
`cc2` exists on disk (`nodes/cc2-node.nix`, `hosts/cc2/`) but is **commented out** of the `nodes` attrset in `flake.nix`.
:::

## Evaluation flow

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "How a node becomes a system"
flowchart LR
  A[flake.nix] --> B[nodes/ccN-node.nix]
  B --> C[lib/mkNode.nix]
  C --> D[hosts/ccN/ccN-config.nix]
  C --> E[hosts/ccN/ccN.nix]
  E --> F[modules/shared.nix]
  F --> G[modules/bundles/*]
  F --> H[modules/apps/*]
  D --> I[modules/system/*]
  D --> J[modules/profiles/admin.nix]
  G -.->|sets enable flags| H
```

## `lib/mkNode.nix`

Injects into every NixOS node: NUR overlay, `agenix`, `disko`, `home-manager`
(`useGlobalPkgs`, `useUserPackages`, `backupFileExtension = "backup"`), and `nix-flatpak`
into the user's HM imports. Passes `inputs`, `isNixOS`, `hostName`, `username` as
`extraSpecialArgs` — `isNixOS` is the flag app modules branch on for Fedora parity.

# System modules

Files in `modules/system/`. Imported explicitly per host — **not** auto-discovered.

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| `core-config.nix` | Flakes on, `allowUnfree`, systemd-boot + EFI, `linuxPackages_latest`, TZ `Europe/Berlin`, `en_US.UTF-8` w/ German `LC_*`, cachix substituters (`comfyui`, `nix-community`), NetworkManager, firewall (trusts `tailscale0`, opens 41641/5353/TCP 5960-5970 for NDI), openssh, Tailscale w/ `--ssh`, CUPS, zsh, `nix-ld`. Also runs **kanata** system-wide bound to one Cherry USB keyboard on TCP 10000, with `RestrictAddressFamilies` force-overridden so `hyprkan.py` can connect. Ships `brightnessctl`, `firefox`. |
| `gui-config.nix` | `hardware.graphics` (+32-bit), Wayland/Ozone session vars, X11, SDDM, Plasma 6 fallback, Hyprland + XWayland, dconf, and the xdg-portal stack: `termfilechooser` as FileChooser, `hyprland` + `gtk` as defaults. |
| `audio-config.nix` | PipeWire (ALSA + 32-bit, Pulse, JACK), rtkit, PulseAudio off. |
| `ndi.nix` | Avahi w/ mDNS `.local` publishing + OBS wrapped with the `distroav` NDI plugin, `ndi-6` src hash force-overridden. |
| `ollama.nix` | `ollama-cuda` service; declaratively pulls `gemma4`, `batiai/qwen3.6-35b:iq4`, `qwen2:0.5b`. |
| `comfyui.nix` | ComfyUI w/ CUDA + Manager, `/var/lib/comfyui`, bound to `127.0.0.1` (firewall closed — reached via Tailscale), `--use-sage-attention`. Pins `ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts` and `ComfyUI-Z-Image-Turbo-Resolutions`. |
| `opencode.nix` | `writeShellScriptBin` wrapper: `npx opencode-ai@latest`, forwards `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. |
| `rave.nix` | IRCAM RAVE in a `buildFHSEnv` with a pinned `uv` venv (deps unpackageable in nixpkgs). Options: `version` (2.3.1), `torchSpec`, `torchBackend`, `extraDeps`. Subcommands `sync` / `env` / passthrough. |

: `modules/system/` {#tbl-system tbl-colwidths="[18,82]"}

## `modules/profiles/admin.nix`

`admin` user (zsh, groups `networkmanager wheel uinput`, `kdePackages.kate`), root, both with
the same ed25519 authorized key and `hashedPasswordFile = /etc/admin.pass`.
`wheelNeedsPassword = true`. tmpfiles rule for `/home/admin` 0700.

## `modules/experiments/piratebox.nix`

Offline captive-portal mesh node: hostapd open AP on `wlan0`, dnsmasq DHCP + wildcard DNS
sinkhole to `10.0.0.1`, filebrowser on 8080, nginx captive-portal redirects, tmpfiles-seeded
wiki tree. **Not imported anywhere.** See @sec-observations.

## `hosts/installer/installer.nix`

Minimal installation ISO that unattendedly runs `disko-install` for `cc1` against a pinned
NVMe by-id path, seeding `/etc/admin.pass` from the ISO. Refuses if the target disk has
mounted partitions; 10s abort window.

# Bundles

All five files in `modules/bundles/` are auto-imported by `shared.nix`, so they apply to
**every** HM user. `core.nix` and `common.nix` only flip `myModules.apps.*.enable` flags; the
other three add content unconditionally.

| Bundle | Contents |
|---|---|
| `core.nix` | Enables `dunst eza fzf fastfetch git hyprland kanata kitty lazygit polkit rofi ssh starship syncthing waybar yazi zellij zsh` |
| `common.nix` | Enables `ags direnv gpg firefox gh-dash mpv swayimg vlc wlr-which-key zathura` (`espanso` commented out) |
| `dotfiles.nix` | `programs.home-manager`, fontconfig, `~/.scripts` (executable, recursive), `~/.local/share/fonts`, nvim as a **mutable out-of-store symlink**, `user-dirs.dirs`, `mimeapps.list`, `browser`, and an `fd/ignore` (Trash, .git, backups, vault, mnt) |
| `packages.nix` | The everywhere-package list — see @sec-packages |
| `nix-packages.nix` | `lib.mkIf isNixOS` — NixOS-only packages Fedora gets from dnf |

: `modules/bundles/` {#tbl-bundles tbl-colwidths="[20,80]"}

# App modules

Every file in `modules/apps/` follows the same shape: `options.myModules.apps.<name>.enable`
plus `lib.mkIf`. `shared.nix` imports all of them; the bundles decide what's on. Most are
thin — declare the package, symlink `static/<name>` into `~/.config`.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Enabled by core

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| `dunst.nix` | dunst pkg + static config |
| `eza.nix` | eza w/ zsh aliases, git column, icons, `--group-directories-first --header` |
| `fastfetch.nix` | fastfetch + `config.jsonc` |
| `fzf.nix` | fzf w/ **fasd frecency piped ahead of `fd`** and `--tiebreak=index` to preserve that ordering; bat preview; catppuccin-ish colors |
| `git.nix` | git w/ `diffnav` as pager for diff/show/log, nvim editor, rebase-on-pull, ignores `.direnv/` |
| `hyprland.nix` | Symlinks `static/hypr`; picks `sources-nixos.conf` vs `sources-fedora.conf` off `isNixOS` |
| `kanata.nix` | Config files only — the daemon is a system service in `core-config.nix` |
| `kitty.nix` | Config only; binary comes from `nix-packages.nix` |
| `lazygit.nix` | lazygit + static config |
| `polkit.nix` | polkit-gnome agent as a user service, `ConditionEnvironment=XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=hyprland` so it doesn't collide with the Plasma fallback. NixOS-gated |
| `rofi.nix` | rofi + `xdotool` + static config |
| `ssh.nix` | `enableDefaultConfig = false`; `*` block w/ hashed known-hosts and ControlMaster / `master-%C` / 10m persist |
| `starship.nix` | starship pkg + `static/starship` |
| `syncthing.nix` | HM service on NixOS; a hand-written user unit (`syncthing-fedora`) with correct exit-code handling when `!isNixOS` |
| `waybar.nix` | Declarative `mainBar` (top, non-exclusive, h49) merged with `static/waybar` for `modules.json`. Right side: mpd, pulseaudio, network, tray, custom/vault, battery, clock |
| `yazi.nix` | Yazi behind a `writeShellScriptBin` wrapper (debug hook). Separate `portal.enable` sub-option installs `yazi-picker.sh` for `xdg-desktop-portal-termfilechooser`, launching kitty w/ `-u DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS` and handling save/dir/open cases |
| `zellij.nix` | Zellij w/ all shell integrations off; static `config.kdl` plus a generated `zjstatus.kdl` layout — pinned floating status pane, mode/tab formatting, git-branch command module, Europe/London clock, vertical/horizontal swap layouts |
| `zsh.nix` | zsh in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/zsh`, oh-my-zsh w/ `fasd` plugin (no theme), syntax highlighting. Re-sources `hm-session-vars.sh` in both `initContent` and `envExtra` to survive Wayland/SSH env drops; loads `zsh-autocomplete` last, reclaims `^S` for fzf history, unbinds the Alt-hjkl fasd keys |

: Host comparison {#tbl-hosts}

`alle` (second user, all hosts) is a plain NixOS user on bash — except on cc1, where it gets
zsh and a hand-picked HM import list: `fzf git kitty lazygit pi ssh starship t3code zsh`
plus the `dotfiles`, `nix-packages` and `packages` bundles.

Rebuild aliases per host:

```bash
ns   # cd ~/.config/home-manager && git add -A && sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#ccN && cd -
nd   # zellij delete-session 'ccN' --force
```

# Observations {#sec-observations}

::: {.callout-important}
## `piratebox.nix` reuses broot's option key

It declares `options.myModules.apps.broot.enable = mkEnableOption "piratebox"` and gates on
it. Harmless today only because `modules/experiments/` isn't auto-imported — importing it
would either collide with `broot.nix` or silently turn on an open Wi-Fi AP when broot is
enabled. Rename to `myModules.experiments.piratebox.enable`.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Runtime `npx` breaks reproducibility

The `opencode` flake input is unused; `modules/system/opencode.nix` runs
`npx opencode-ai@latest` at eval-free runtime instead. Same pattern in `pi.nix`
(`npx @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`). Neither pins a version, and neither works offline.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Smaller items

- **Dormant app modules:** `broot`, `libreoffice`, `stirling-pdf`, `supercollider`, `tmux`, `vifm`.
- **`cc2` is orphaned** — full host + node definitions exist but it's commented out of `flake.nix`.
- **`secrets/secrets.nix` is an empty stub** despite `agenix` being wired into every node.
- **`/etc/*.pass` files are out-of-band.** The installer seeds `admin.pass`; nothing seeds `alle.pass`.
- **Kanata is device-pinned** to one Cherry USB keyboard by-id path in `core-config.nix`, shared across all hosts.
- `system.stateVersion` is `26.05` vs `home.stateVersion` `25.05` — intentional, but don't let it drift further.
:::
